description: Create a crypto invoice that adds a data plan to an existing eSIM (no new QR, nothing to install). plan_id must come from list_topups for this ICCID. Payment and polling work exactly like create_order.

iccid.description: ICCID of the installed eSIM (18-22 digits, printed in the eSIM settings)

network.description: Network from list_payment_coins, e.g. "tron", "solana". Required for USDT (several networks).
